قد تخرج تكلفة الزواج في الأردن عن السيطر: The cost of marriage in Jordan can quickly get out of control if there isn't a clear plan from the start. Here are practical ideas:
حدد سقفاً إجمالياً قبل أن تبدأ بحجز أي ش: Set an overall ceiling before you start booking anything
— كثير من العرسان يبدؤون بحجز القاعة أو: — Many grooms start by booking the hall or buying gold without a clear ceiling, then find they have exceeded the budget on other items. Set the total figure first, then distribute it across the items.
رتّب البنود بحسب أولويتك أنت لا بحسب \"ا: Prioritize the items by what matters to you, not by “custom”
— فليس كل عرس يحتاج إلى مستوى الإنفاق نف: — Not every wedding needs the same level of spending on every item. If the hall matters more to you than the photography, for example, allocate a bigger share to it and cut back on another item — flexibility here saves real money.
قارن أسعار القاعات والمصورين مبكراً ومن: Compare hall and photographer prices early and from more than one place
— فالأسعار تختلف كثيراً بحسب الموسم (الص: — Prices vary a lot by season (summer and holidays are peak times and are usually pricier) and by location. Booking early can also secure a better price than booking at the last minute.
وزّع التوفير على مدة أطول إذا أمكن: Spread the savings over a longer period if possible
— فالتوفير الشهري الصغير على مدى سنة أو: — Small monthly savings over a year or more are much easier than trying to gather a large sum in a short time, and they reduce the chance of resorting to a loan or debt to cover the difference.
ناقش الميزانية بصراحة مع شريك حياتك وأهل: Discuss the budget openly with your partner and family from the start
— فخلافات كثيرة حول تكلفة الزواج سببها ت: — Many disputes over wedding cost are caused by mismatched expectations between the two sides that were not discussed early. A clear early agreement saves time, money and stress.
